lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's twenty-four? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 24? Nope!

lines.text: A right triangle has legs twelve and nine. Its copy slides four to the right.
lines.caption: A right triangle has legs 12 and 9. Its copy slides 4 to the right.

lines.text: What is the area of the shaded part?
lines.caption: What is the area of the shaded part?

lines.text: Here's the trick. The whole triangle has area fifty-four.
lines.caption: Here's the trick. The whole triangle has area 54.

lines.text: The overlap is a smaller copy of the same shape!
lines.caption: The overlap is a smaller copy of the same shape!

lines.text: Its bottom is eight out of twelve, so its height is six.
lines.caption: Its bottom is 8 out of 12, so its height is 6.

lines.text: The overlap's area is one over two, times eight, times six. That's twenty-four.
lines.caption: The overlap's area is 1/2 × 8 × 6. That's 24.

lines.text: Twenty-four was the trap. It's just the overlap.
lines.caption: 24 was the trap. It's just the overlap.

lines.text: Did you get thirty? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 30? Tell me below!
